# Code of conduct

Whiteflow follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
In short: be respectful, assume good intent, and keep discussion about the work.

If someone's behaviour isn't acceptable, report it to the maintainers through a private advisory (the repository's
**Security** tab, **Report a vulnerability**) with "Conduct" in the title. Reports are kept confidential.
